# Deviload 2.11.0

**Make Devil Music your own.** A new theme puts your own picture or video behind the app, and the layout of Devil Music can now be rearranged.

- Choose the Your own theme and put a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF picture, or an MP4 or WebM video, behind the app. Videos loop without sound. Files up to 300 MB work, about 2 to 5 minutes of Full HD video; a loop of 10 to 60 seconds looks best.
- Tune blur down to none, darkening, panel transparency, ambient light and the accent colour, or let the accent follow the cover.
- Open Edit layout from the Themes menu or the player's More menu. Drag blocks and player buttons to another place, hide the ones you do not need with the eye, swap the side panels or reset everything.
- Watch music videos in the mini-player. Its video window can be resized freely and pinned above other windows; the controls fade until you point at it.

### Devil Music

Folding the library now leaves a slim rail with the sections, a create button and your playlist covers. The Now Playing switch to the lyrics carries a Lyrics label. A music video found once is remembered, so the mini-player and later sessions open it sooner. What's new also lists earlier releases, and the ones you skipped open on their own.

Player buttons no longer overlap at medium window widths, and the library fits narrow windows without scrolling sideways or slipping under the main content.

### Deviload

Leftover files from earlier updates and old music engines are cleaned up shortly after start.

On Windows, run the setup EXE over your installed copy to keep your library and settings. Deleting your playlists and app data is only an option in the uninstaller and is off by default.
